out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF THE POLICY. PLEASE KEEP THE CLEANUP PROCEDURE ONSITE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hand: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE ATTEMPT TO CUT LETTUCE WITH ONE GLOVED HAND AND ONE BARE HAND.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PIC DISCARDED OF LETTUCE DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND THAT STAFF UNDERSTAND HANDWASHING/BARE HAND CONTACT PROCEDURES.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS OVER PRODUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER; OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN OVER SAUCES IN THE LEFT TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLERS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food items for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED FRIED TOFU, NOODLES, BEAN SPROUTS, AND CUT CABBAGE ON TIME WITHOUT A FOUR-HOUR TIME LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC ADDED TIME MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURES. LA ONG THAI BISTRO (Inspection Date: 09/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED FROZEN RAW BEEF AND RAW CHICKEN (IN BAGS) THAWING IN THE SANITIZER COMPARTMENT OF THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PIC PUT ALL THAWING MEAT IN THE WALK-IN COOLER DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF UNDERSTAND PROPER THAWING METHODS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED CARDBOARD LINING SHELVES AND TINFOIL LINING A CART IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC UNDERSTANDS CARDBOARD/TINFOIL SHOULD NOT BE USED TO LINE SHELVES AS THEY ARE NOT DURABLE. PLEASE CONSIDER USING PLEXI-GLASS, STAINLESS STEEL, OR ANOTHER DURABLE MATERIAL IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WOULD LIKE TO LINE SHELVES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: OBSERVED EXPIRED BLEACH TEST KIT AT THE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a NEW BLEACH test kit. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH SOME TEST STRIPS FOR THE TIME-BEING.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW BEEF IN THE RIGHT TWO-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EHS REVIEWED PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION PROCEDURES WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN AND SANITIZE THE ICE MACHINE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED BEEF IN THE RIGHT TWO DOOR PREP TOP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS REVIEWED NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE PROCESS AND UNDERSTANDS WRITTEN PROCEDURES SHOULD BE SUBMITTED BEFORE PARTIALLY COOKING BEEF AGAIN.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: EHS OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH A CUTTING BOARD AND PLACE IT ON A SHELF TO AIR-DRY WITHOUT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC AND EHS PROVIDED EMPLOYEE WITH GUIDANCE ON PROPER WASHING, RINSING, AND SANITIZING. PIC WILL ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND HOW TO PROPERLY WASH/RINSE/SANITIZE EQUIPMENT AND DISHWARE.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED CHICKEN IN RIGHT TWO-DOOR PREP TOP, MADE APPROXIMATELY 2 HOURS PRIOR AT 55-70F.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PIC DISCARDED CHICKEN DURING INSPECTION AND AGREED TO DISCONTINUE PROCESS AS OF NOW. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW MEATS MUST BE FULLY COOKED DURING THE FIRST COOK STEP, OR WRITTEN PROCEDURES AND DOCUMENTATION MUST BE SUBMITTED TO HEALTH DEPARTMENT IF FACILITY DECIDES TO CONTINUE WITH NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS. PLEASE REACH OUT TO THE EHS IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS ABOUT PROCESS.
